metadata.name: ISO/IEC 27001:2022
metadata.issuing_body: International Organization for Standardization (ISO) / International Electrotechnical Commission (IEC)
metadata.description: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 specifies the requirements for establishing, implementing, maintaining and continually improving an information security management system (ISMS). The 2022 revision restructured Annex A controls from 114 to 93.

requirements.title: Information Security Policies
requirements.description: A policy for information security and topic-specific policies shall be defined, approved by management, published, communicated to and acknowledged by relevant personnel and relevant interested parties, and reviewed at planned intervals.
requirements.guidance: Define a documented IS policy signed by executive management. Review at least annually.

requirements.title: Information Security Roles and Responsibilities
requirements.description: Information security roles and responsibilities shall be defined and allocated according to the needs of the organization.
requirements.guidance: Document the RACI for information security. Assign an CISO or equivalent role.

requirements.title: Threat Intelligence
requirements.description: Information relating to information security threats shall be collected and analysed to produce threat intelligence.
requirements.guidance: Subscribe to threat intelligence feeds. Integrate findings into risk assessment and security controls.

requirements.title: Information Security for Use of Cloud Services
requirements.description: Processes for acquisition, use, management and exit from cloud services shall be established in accordance with the organization's information security requirements.
requirements.guidance: Define cloud security policy covering shared-responsibility model, data residency, and exit strategy.

requirements.title: Screening
requirements.description: Background verification checks on all candidates for employment shall be carried out prior to joining the organization, on an ongoing basis taking into consideration applicable laws, regulations and ethics.
requirements.guidance: Conduct pre-employment background checks. Re-verify for sensitive role changes.

requirements.title: Physical Security Perimeters
requirements.description: Security perimeters shall be defined and used to protect areas that contain information and other associated assets.
requirements.guidance: Define physical security zones. Implement access controls, CCTV, and visitor logs for data center areas.

requirements.title: Privileged Access Rights
requirements.description: The allocation and use of privileged access rights shall be restricted and managed.
requirements.guidance: Implement just-in-time privileged access. Require MFA for all privileged sessions. Audit privilege usage.

requirements.title: Secure Authentication
requirements.description: Secure authentication technologies and procedures shall be implemented based on information access restrictions and the topic-specific policy on access control.
requirements.guidance: Enforce MFA for all user accounts. Prohibit shared credentials. Use phishing-resistant authenticators for privileged accounts.

requirements.title: Management of Technical Vulnerabilities
requirements.description: Information about technical vulnerabilities of information systems in use shall be obtained in a timely fashion, the organization's exposure to such vulnerabilities shall be evaluated and appropriate measures shall be taken.
requirements.guidance: Implement vulnerability scanning with defined SLAs: Critical ≤7 days, High ≤30 days, Medium ≤90 days.

requirements.title: Configuration Management
requirements.description: Configurations, including security configurations, of hardware, software, services and networks shall be established, documented, implemented, monitored and reviewed.
requirements.guidance: Maintain a configuration baseline. Detect and alert on configuration drift. Use infrastructure-as-code.

requirements.title: Logging
requirements.description: Logs that record activities, exceptions, faults and other relevant events shall be produced, stored, protected and analysed.
requirements.guidance: Centralise logs in a SIEM. Define retention periods. Protect log integrity. Alert on anomalies.

requirements.title: Monitoring Activities
requirements.description: Networks, systems and applications shall be monitored for anomalous behaviour and appropriate actions taken to evaluate potential information security incidents.
requirements.guidance: Implement continuous monitoring. Define and tune detection rules. Establish escalation procedures.

requirements.title: Secure Coding
requirements.description: Secure coding principles shall be applied to software development.
requirements.guidance: Enforce SAST/DAST in CI pipelines. Train developers in secure coding. Conduct code reviews for security issues.

requirements.title: Protection of Information Systems During Audit Testing
requirements.description: Audit tests and other assurance activities involving assessment of operational systems shall be planned and agreed between the tester and appropriate management.
requirements.guidance: Obtain written authorisation for all penetration tests. Define scope and rules of engagement.
